classification: outcome-informed old-seed architecture calibration on theory-selected delay extremes

source.selection_reason: test no-delay and maximum registered-delay stability extremes

mandatory_gates.R1: all 9,216 endpoints and 288 cells complete and finite
mandatory_gates.R2: nonstationary geometric cumulative-risk improvement at least 7 percent
mandatory_gates.R3: strict improvement in at least 55 percent of nonstationary cells
mandatory_gates.R4: both nonstationary schedules improve at least 3 percent
mandatory_gates.R5: delay 0 and delay 3 each improve at least 3 percent
mandatory_gates.R9: 240 learning transitions, zero extra probes, at most 18 messages
mandatory_gates.R10: certificate rho/effective-sample directions match temporal correlation
mandatory_gates.R11: positive collaboration, finite debt, mean QP iterations at most 35
